skip: The article has about 250 words of substance and nearly all of it is already in the description. The only additions would be: the Mughal general Diler Khan's coercion, the alliance with Sambhaji, the fall of Bijapur on 12 September 1686, Sikandar brought before Aurangzeb in silver chains, imprisonment and death at Daulatabad Fort on 3 April 1700, and burial at Bijapur at the foot of his teacher Naimullah Hashmi. Enough for one sentence in the description, not for sections. (The article says he was enthroned 'at five years of age' in 1672 though born 1668.)
